mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.audit_no AS auditNo, ar.audit_type AS auditType, ar.business_id AS stationId, pcs.name AS stationName, pcs.location_name AS stationLocation, pcs.owner_id AS stationOwnerId, owner.name AS stationOwnerName, owner.phone AS stationOwnerPhone, ar.applicant_id AS applicantId, u.name AS applicantName, u.phone AS applicantPhone, u.avatar AS applicantAvatar, ar.title, ar.content, ar.attachments, ar.current_status AS currentStatus, ar.priority, ar.current_admin_id AS currentAdminId, adm.name AS currentAdminName, ar.submit_time AS submitTime, ar.finish_time AS finishTime, ar.final_opinion AS finalOpinion, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN user_info u ON ar.applicant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN private_charge_station pcs ON ar.business_id = pcs.id LEFT JOIN user_info owner ON pcs.owner_id = owner.id LEFT JOIN admin_info adm ON ar.current_admin_id = adm.id WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, audit_no AS auditNo, audit_type AS auditType, business_id AS businessId, applicant_id AS applicantId, title, content, attachments, current_status AS currentStatus, current_admin_id AS currentAdminId, priority, submit_time AS submitTime, finish_time AS finishTime, final_opinion AS finalOpinion, reject_reason AS rejectReason, is_deleted AS isDeleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM audit_record WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, current_admin_id = #{currentAdminId}, priority = #{priority},
finish_time = #{finishTime},
final_opinion = #{finalOpinion},
reject_reason = #{rejectReason},
update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (audit_id, admin_id, action, from_status, to_status, opinion, create_time) VALUES (#{auditId}, #{adminId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{opinion}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT al.id, al.admin_id AS adminId, adm.name AS adminName, al.action, al.from_status AS fromStatus, al.to_status AS toStatus, al.opinion, al.create_time AS createTime FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_info adm ON al.admin_id = adm.id WHERE al.audit_id = #{auditId} ORDER BY al.create_time DESC

SELECT -- 投诉统计 SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complaintTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 2 AND current_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complaintPending, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 2 AND current_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complaintProcessing, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 2 AND current_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complaintPassed, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 2 AND current_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complaintRejected, -- 故障统计 SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 3 AND current_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultPending, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 3 AND current_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultProcessing, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 3 AND current_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultPassed, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 3 AND current_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS faultRejected, -- 紧急与今日 SUM(CASE WHEN priority = 3 AND current_status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urgentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(submit_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCount FROM audit_record WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND audit_type IN (2, 3)
